verses.text: And Elihu continued:
“Bear with me a little longer, and I will show you that there is more to be said on God’s behalf.

xrefs.text: Bear with me while I speak; then, after I have spoken, you may go on mocking.
Therefore we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God were making His appeal through us. We implore you on behalf of Christ: Be reconciled to God.
Will you speak wickedly on God’s behalf or speak deceitfully for Him?
I urge you, brothers, to bear with my word of exhortation, for I have only written to you briefly.
Pay attention, Job, and listen to me; be silent, and I will speak.

verses.text: I get my knowledge from afar, and I will ascribe justice to my Maker.

xrefs.text: But the wisdom from above is first of all pure, then peace-loving, gentle, accommodating, full of mercy and good fruit, impartial, and sincere.

Does God pervert justice? Does the Almighty pervert what is right?

verses.text: Indeed, God is mighty, but He despises no one; He is mighty in strength of understanding.

verses.text: Can your wealth or all your mighty effort keep you from distress?

xrefs.text: Riches are worthless in the day of wrath, but righteousness brings deliverance from death.
Be assured that the wicked will not go unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will escape.
In that day men will cast away to the moles and bats their idols of silver and gold— the idols they made to worship.
Ill-gotten treasures profit nothing, but righteousness brings deliverance from death.
Your gold and silver are corroded. Their corrosion will testify against you and consume your flesh like fire. You have hoarded treasure in the last days.

verses.text: Do not long for the night, when people vanish from their homes.

xrefs.text: Therefore, He recognizes their deeds; He overthrows them in the night and they are crushed.
They die in an instant, in the middle of the night. The people convulse and pass away; the mighty are removed without human hand.

Now at midnight the LORD struck down every firstborn male in the land of Egypt, from the firstborn of Pharaoh, who sat on his throne, to the firstborn of the prisoner in the dungeon, as well as all the firstborn among the livestock.
And that very night the angel of the LORD went out and struck down 185,000 men in the camp of the Assyrians. When the people got up the next morning, there were all the dead bodies!
That very night Belshazzar king of the Chaldeans was slain,

verses.text: Be careful not to turn to iniquity, for this you have preferred to affliction.

xrefs.text: If I had cherished iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not have listened.
